title: A steam explosion at Yellowstone nobody saw coming #Shorts
description:
July 23, 2024. The ground at Biscuit Basin lets go. Steam, mud and rock blast 600 feet into the air, boulders land on the boardwalk, and not one instrument saw it coming.

▶ Full documentary (Part 1, What's Really Under Yellowstone): https://youtu.be/-vkXqMrSljM

#Shorts #Yellowstone #NationalParks #History #Volcano
